title: Warm Spicy Venezuelan Chinese Broccoli Stew
description: A spicy and comforting stew featuring Chinese broccoli, perfect for a sick day, made with a blend of Venezuelan and Chinese flavors, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese broccoli and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan hot sauce, chicken broth, coconut milk, cumin, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Deglaze the pot with a little bit of water to remove any browned bits from the bottom.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle the stew into agave leaf vessels and serve hot.
